content.short: MARS2049 is a Build-to-Earn Telegram mini app with dice rolling, Mars base building, upgrades, and resource progression.
content.description: MARS2049 combines a Monopoly-style dice board with Mars settlement building. Players roll dice, trigger events, collect coins, build research bases, living pods, and eco-farms, then upgrade resources with tools as they progress through the Telegram mini app. MARS2049 is a revolutionary Build-to-Earn Telegram mini app game. Combining Monopoly-style strategic dice rolling with building development, experience unparalleled pioneering adventures on Mars. The Web3 layer matters because ownership, rewards, Telegram distribution, or token mechanics are part of the loop.
